describes: packages/plugin/annotation: the v3 page-space reads and writes, the change events, the selection and rich-text verbs, attachments and stamps without a pointer, the measurement seam and the v3 document events.

cases.name: page-space-reads
cases.covers: get projects a loaded record into page space (bounds, geometry per kind, props, flags, text, author, dates, group, reply, authority, raw) once per model entry; list filters by page, subtype, author and group, memoizing the whole and per-page lists; listRaw and getRaw read the DTOs; hitTestAt answers the annotation under a point, the selection for a handle, null over empty space even with a selection; getStatus is loading until hydration lands; listTools and getTool project the resolved tools.

cases.name: create-from-page-space
cases.covers: create stages page-space input through the one createAnnot path a draw tool takes: tool defaults, the tool’s /F seed under the input’s, props over defaults, optional selection; it resolves the engine’s ref once confirmed and announces onCreated with an api origin; an engine refusal rolls the entry back and rejects. Each geometry kind lowers to its draft. A page the document lacks, invalid geometry, an unknown tool and a subtype create cannot build reject without staging. createMany folds per-input outcomes into a batch result.

cases.name: update-in-page-space
cases.covers: update lowers page-space bounds, geometry per kind, props, flags, contents and rich text through the repository projection and one engine write, announcing onUpdated; rich text commits through the text door. A geometry of the wrong kind, bounds on a vertex kind, a props patch the annotation refuses, and an unloaded ref reject. setRotation and rotateBy write the geometry scope (a markup does not rotate); updateRaw sends a PDF-space patch as is; updateMany and deleteMany fold per-ref outcomes; delete announces onDeleted.

cases.name: selection-verbs
cases.covers: selectAll selects every selectable annotation, or one page’s; selectInRect selects what intersects the rect, and an additive empty hit leaves the selection; rotateSelectionBy(-90) rotates each member through setRotation; resetSelectionRotation awaits its writes; updateSelection, updateSelectionFlags and deleteSelection settle into a batch result that names each refused member once.

cases.name: text-range-needs-an-active-edit
cases.covers: getSelectionProps reads the range keys from the runs only while the ranged annotation is being edited and the range is not a bare caret; otherwise they come from the body.

cases.name: rich-text-editing
cases.covers: setContents and setRichText commit through the one debounced text write immediately; draftRichText stages a paragraph edit and schedules the write; setTextSelection stores the editor range (a repeat is a no-op, null clears, a change of start alone is a change) and the range keys of getSelectionProps then read the runs it covers; updateSelection restyles those runs as a delta (flushing first) while the other keys restyle the body; toggleTextFormat flips a format from the current value; endTextEdit flushes and drops the range; getEditingRef and getCssFontFamily read back.

cases.name: attachments-stamps-and-downloads
cases.covers: createAttachment places the attachment tool’s icon at a point with its defaults and the picked file, selects and announces it; a page the document lacks rejects not-found; an engine refusal rejects as a PluginError. placeStamp sniffs the bytes and places them exactly as a click does, rejecting junk and a page with no crop. readAttachment rejects on an engine whose page service has no downloadFile.

cases.name: measurement-distance-drafts
cases.covers: A dimension tool is inert on a page with no viewports; setPageViewports supplies them, and the scale comes from the viewport under the first point (the last containing one) or the fallback, a foreign scale refusing the draft. The distance tool drags its endpoints, then places the offset between clicks (distanceCreationPage names the page, the edit handler stands down and the hover projects onto it), and the next click commits a LineDimension draft with its caption and leader. The perimeter tool builds a PolyLineDimension. The calibrate tool captures the line in PDF space through onDraftCaptured instead of creating, and needs doc.annotate.modify.

cases.name: dimension-drafts-continue-without-viewports
cases.covers: A dimension draft already under way keeps taking clicks on its own page after the viewports are withdrawn, for the perimeter and the distance tools; a click on another page, which has none, starts nothing.

cases.name: calibration-needs-modify
cases.covers: The calibrate capture tool is inert without doc.annotate.modify, even with create authority.

cases.name: remeasure-page
cases.covers: remeasurePage rehydrates, then rewrites the scale of every dimension on the page it can, reporting each updated ref and each one skipped: no update authority, locked, a foreign measure, or a scale that yields no readout; a refused write lands in failed. A hydration that ends in error reports it instead.

cases.name: remeasure-without-authority-and-after-errors
cases.covers: A dimension this session may not update is skipped as no-authority; a remeasure whose rehydration fails reports the error and changes nothing.

cases.name: v3-document-events
cases.covers: A form field update and a completed signature bump the widgets they repaint (a widget without an annotation address is skipped, a signature without a widget bumps nothing); document.versioned rehydrates; a failed page reload keeps the previous view.

cases.name: finish-drafts-and-the-edit-hub
cases.covers: finishCreationDraft commits a polygon draft and resolves its ref, resolves null with no draft, and finishes a buffered ink draft through its own door; cancel drops a draft.

cases.name: awaited-writes-and-pending-text
cases.covers: A quarter-turn whose write the engine refuses rejects rotateSelectionBy with the lowered error; a debounced text write whose annotation disappeared before the flush is dropped; the file-picker remover clears only the provider it installed; createAttachment refuses when the attachment tool no longer authors an icon kind.
